pageDescription: Search and filter Prism Bloom Exercise event options by name, activity, difficulty, duration, route, location, parking, or meeting point.
Event information is currently being expanded as Prism Bloom Exercise continues to grow. The event library is transitioning to a new data-driven system that stores event details.
During this transition, some events may have limited information available while event data is being reviewed, and added.
Some event details are still being documented. If a duration, parking point, or meeting point is not listed yet, the card will show the current placeholder from the event data.
